description: This file declares the ControlModuleService class and its factory, which implement IPC control module services for the Rialto server. It includes method declarations for client connection management, shared memory access, client registration, and acknowledgment handling, along with class and method definitions relevant to IPC control services.

classes.name: ControlModuleServiceFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of ControlModuleService, implementing the IControlModuleServiceFactory interface.

classes.name: ControlModuleService
classes.description: Implements the IControlModuleService interface, managing IPC client connections, shared memory access, client registration, and acknowledgments within the Rialto server.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IControlModuleService instance, given playback and control services.

methods.name: ControlModuleService
methods.description: Constructor initializing the service with playback and control service references.

methods.name: getSharedMemory
methods.description: Handles requests to retrieve shared memory.
